title: Vampire Vape Koncept Purple Craze Ice 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape’s Purple Craze Ice Shortfill brings together the iconic flavours of Heisenberg and Pinkman, combining the ripe red berries and mixed fruits from Pinkman with the cool hint of menthol and aniseed from the Heisenberg. This unique blend delivers a sweet, tangy, and lightly refreshing vape, making it perfect for fruit and menthol lovers alike. Each 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 0mg nicotine but leaves space for one 10ml nic shot, allowing you to customise your vape to your desired nicotine strength. Simply add 1 x 18mg nic shot to create 60ml of 3mg nicotine e-liquid. With a 70VG/30PG ratio, Purple Craze is ideal for sub-ohm vaping devices and ensures rich flavour and dense vapour production.
